summary: Implemented DatabricksOauthProfileMapping for OAuth (service principal) Databricks connections. Changes: new cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py (login -> client_id, password -> client_secret, auth_type: oauth, client secret via env var COSMOS_CONN_DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET); exports added in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py; OAuth mapping registered before the token mapping in profile_mappings so OAuth connections aren't claimed by the token mapping; new tests in tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py. Tests were not run, per instructions. No commits made. Docs and changelog were not updated.
